newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha yoyos with crude, tenders awarded.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha yoyos with crude, tenders awarded.

text.p: NWE naphtha was little changed as skittish crude markets pulled prices up and down, traders said.
An Israeli refiner won an Alexandria cargo offered in a tender. The price was heard at fob Med high +$8 or $8.50.

A trader was heard having won a Ras Lanuf tender for a cargo loading on September 23-25. The price was heard at fob Med mean +$12.50. A full-range cargo was heard offered at one point at $214 cif NWE, before crude futures fell back by around 60 cents.
Dealers said another trader was later heard offering a Ras Lanuf cargo and thought this may have been the tendered piece.
